67cf09802cdaf5f19447d7f8ddfac52ce688cd30.summary: Check Point Research's DFIR case study of The Gentlemen ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS). An affiliate tried to deploy SystemBC proxy malware during an incident response case, and the report counts over 1,570 SystemBC victims, mostly in the United States. The intrusion used Domain Admin access, Cobalt Strike, PsExec, Group Policy deployment, Defender tampering, AnyDesk and RDP. It ended with Windows, Linux and ESXi lockers that encrypt data and claim exfiltration.

678ad058b3b1d73fd5e594432cb93c111a03ff26.summary: Harfanglab analyses PackXOR, a private packer that Sentinel Labs linked to the AvNeutralizer anti-EDR tool, which it associates with the FIN7 cluster. The report says PackXOR also wraps XMRig cryptominers and R77 rootkit payloads, which it judges unrelated to FIN7. It describes the packer's layered XOR, LZNT1 compression and string encryption, provides an unpacker, and suggests ransomware operators use the packer.

67ef55e2831de87d26032fe2c0cccdf953316efd.summary: Vendor blog by CrowdStrike on the DarkSide ransomware-as-a-service, which it links to the eCrime group CARBON SPIDER. It says DarkSide began as a 2020 ransomware operation, expanded from Windows to Linux, and encrypts virtual machines via VMware ESXi and vCenter. It cites the 2021 fuel pipeline attack and describes how CrowdStrike Falcon detects and blocks the ransomware. Much of the text promotes the Falcon product.
